description: Three different arrivals in SG-1: Jonas’s attempt to make amends, Mitchell’s pursuit of the legendary team and Vala’s journey from opportunistic survival to belonging.

related_resources.reason: Daniel’s radiation injury and Jonas’s decision to defect.
Jonas’s training in Daniel’s texts and his gradual inclusion in the team.
Jonas’s observational abilities in a grounded investigative story.
Jonas’s return and transition toward political service.
Vala’s arrival and her adversarial dynamic with Daniel.
Mitchell’s introduction and credited producer testimony about Carter’s authority.
Mitchell’s vulnerability and identity through manipulated memories.
Vala’s connection to Qetesh and its victims.
Vala’s experience among Ori followers and relationship with Tomin.
Vala and her con artist father.
Finale’s extended team life and evolving bonds.
